Crustless Quiche
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Recipe type: Breakfast
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • 10 oz. mushrooms
  • 8 pieces lunch ham
  • ¼ cup butter (1/2 stick)
  • 10 eggs
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Milk
  • 1 cup cheddar cheese
  • Parmesan cheese
Instructions
  1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
  2. Wash and step mushrooms. Cut mushrooms into slices.
  3. Cut ham into cubes. Place ham, mushrooms, and butter into a twelve inch sauce pan and add 1 teaspoon of salt and ½ teaspoon of pepper. Turn on burner to high and cook until mushrooms are tender, about ten minutes.
  4. Crack eggs into a medium bowl and add ¾ teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon pepper.
  5. Add 2 cups milk and cheese to egg mixture and stir.
  6. Spray glass 9*13 inch pan with nonstick spray. Layer the bottom of the pan with Parmesan cheese.
  7. Add mushroom mixture to the pan.
  8. Add egg mixture to the pan. Add milk until quiche mixture is approximately 1 inch from the top of the pan.
  9. Place in the preheated oven for one hour.
